identity_keywords.zh: 运河与湖泊双重城市性格

visual_character.zh: 雾气中的横向水面层次
白墙黛瓦的江南建筑肌理
visual_character.en: white walls and dark tiled roofs

landmarks.visual_description_zh: 横向延展的长堤、垂柳、水雾和远山层次
landmarks.visual_description_en: long linear causeways with willow edges, light mist, calm water, and distant hills

landmarks.visual_description_zh: 塔身层檐、湖岸远景和朦胧天际线
landmarks.visual_description_en: tiered pagoda silhouette with distant lakeshore profile and soft skyline haze

landmarks.visual_description_zh: 低桥弧线、桥头垂柳和浅雾水面
landmarks.visual_description_en: low bridge arc with willow edges, pale mist, and quiet reflective water

landmarks.visual_description_zh: 运河台阶、旧墙、沿岸生活痕迹和狭长水道
landmarks.visual_description_en: stone canal steps, aged walls, lived-in waterside edges, and narrow canal depth

landmarks.visual_description_zh: 低调宫城文脉、石阶、树影和克制的历史感
landmarks.visual_description_en: subtle imperial-city traces with stone steps, filtered tree shade, and restrained historical mood

architecture.visual_description_zh: 白墙、深色屋檐、低矮体量和安静巷道
architecture.visual_description_en: whitewashed walls, dark rooflines, low building scale, and quiet lanes

architecture.visual_description_zh: 细密瓦片、压低的屋面线条和雨后光泽
architecture.visual_description_en: dense dark roof tiles, lowered roof silhouettes, and subtle post-rain sheen

architecture.visual_description_zh: 通向水面的石阶、边缘青苔和缓慢水纹
architecture.visual_description_en: stone steps descending toward water with moss edges and slow canal ripples

architecture.visual_description_zh: 木格栅、窄门洞和文气十足的院落入口
architecture.visual_description_en: wood lattice doors, narrow entry frames, and scholarly courtyard thresholds

architecture.visual_description_zh: 贴近水面的低桥、温和曲线和静止倒影
architecture.visual_description_en: low bridges crossing still water with gentle arcs and quiet reflections

food.visual_description_zh: 扁平茶叶、青绿色调、白瓷茶器和清淡蒸汽
food.visual_description_en: flat green tea leaves, pale green tones, white porcelain tea ware, and delicate steam

food.visual_description_zh: 整鱼摆盘、浅色酱汁和江南宴席器皿
food.visual_description_en: whole-fish plating with light glaze and refined Jiangnan banquet tableware

food.visual_description_zh: 浅色竹笋片、青瓷小盘和春季轻盈感
food.visual_description_en: pale bamboo shoots, celadon side plates, and a spring-like lightness

food.visual_description_zh: 淡黄色糖霜、半透明糕点和秋季香甜气息
food.visual_description_en: light yellow glaze, translucent pastries, and a soft autumn sweetness

food.visual_description_zh: 细口白瓷、浅色桌面和文雅餐席细节
food.visual_description_en: fine white porcelain, pale table surfaces, and elegant riverside dining details

craft_and_culture.visual_description_zh: 竹匾、嫩茶叶、手工翻炒和微微蒸汽
craft_and_culture.visual_description_en: bamboo trays, fresh tea leaves, hand-roasting motion, and light steam haze

craft_and_culture.visual_description_zh: 笔墨纸砚、低案、卷轴和安静书房光线
craft_and_culture.visual_description_en: brushes, inkstone, paper, low desk surfaces, scrolls, and quiet study light

craft_and_culture.visual_description_zh: 柔软布面、浅色织纹和轻垂的布料感
craft_and_culture.visual_description_en: soft silk surfaces, pale woven textures, and lightly draped fabric movement

craft_and_culture.visual_description_zh: 印章石、墨迹、留白和文人手作感
craft_and_culture.visual_description_en: seal stones, brush ink traces, negative space, and literati handcraft mood

craft_and_culture.visual_description_zh: 木书架、纸页、茶盏和安静靠窗阅读场景
craft_and_culture.visual_description_en: wood bookshelves, paper textures, tea cups, and quiet window-side reading scenes

nature.visual_description_zh: 平静浅水、轻雾、水纹和柔和天光倒影
nature.visual_description_en: calm shallow water, light mist, soft ripples, and muted sky reflections

nature.visual_description_zh: 层叠茶垄、山坡小径、晨雾和柔和绿色
nature.visual_description_en: layered tea fields, hillside paths, morning mist, and soft green tones

nature.name_en: spring willow and early blossom palette
nature.visual_description_zh: 浅绿柳丝、零星花枝和湿润春晨空气
nature.visual_description_en: pale willow threads, sparse blossoms, and moist spring-morning air

nature.visual_description_zh: 圆形荷叶、粉白荷花和靠水边的柔和生长感
nature.visual_description_en: round lotus leaves, pale pink blossoms, and soft waterside growth texture

nature.visual_description_zh: 贴近山脚的薄雾、灰蓝山体和层叠远景
nature.visual_description_en: low-lying mist over foothills with blue-gray mountain layering

must_include_when_relevant.zh: 茶山场景应体现龙井茶垄结构，不要退化成普通绿色山坡
must_include_when_relevant.en: tea-hill scenes should show structured Longjing terraces instead of generic green mountains

must_include_when_relevant.zh: 江南街巷场景应保留白墙、瓦顶和石路质感
must_include_when_relevant.en: jiangnan street scenes should preserve white walls, tiled roofs, and stone paving

must_include_when_relevant.zh: 湖景场景优先使用长堤、桥、堤岸或精致水边结构，而不是泛化明信片构图
must_include_when_relevant.en: lake scenes should favor causeways, bridges, embankments, or refined waterside edges over generic postcard icons

avoid_generic_patterns.zh: 不要把杭州反复压缩成亭子、小船、荷花的重复组合
avoid_generic_patterns.en: do not reduce Hangzhou to pavilion-boat-lotus repetition

avoid_generic_patterns.zh: 避免把杭州画成泛化的中国湖边小镇
avoid_generic_patterns.en: avoid treating Hangzhou as a generic chinese lake town

avoid_generic_patterns.zh: 避免没有城市结构支撑的大面积空泛水面
avoid_generic_patterns.en: avoid overusing empty panoramic water surfaces without city-specific structure

cover_bias.zh: 杭州封面适合在文人气与明确空间结构之间取得平衡
cover_bias.en: Hangzhou covers work best when they balance literary calm with one strong place-defining structure

cover_bias.zh: 茶 craft 和运河 texture 是跳出西湖主图的重要方向
cover_bias.en: tea craft and canal texture can diversify the city beyond West Lake hero shots

scene_balance_notes.zh: 不要让五张封面都回到同一种湖景母版
scene_balance_notes.en: do not let all five cover scenes return to the same lake composition

scene_balance_notes.zh: 保留一到两个城市名片场景，其余应分流到茶、运河、巷道和文化细节
scene_balance_notes.en: keep one or two city-name scenes, then diversify into tea, canal, lane, and quiet cultural detail
